items.quote:
I highly recommend Kacper and KK Coaching. I’ve been working with him since April, and I’m really happy with my progress. What I appreciate most is that both the nutrition and training plans are realistic, personalized, and adjusted to my goals, lifestyle, and abilities. Even during my knee injury, he has always tried to find the best solutions for me so I can continue working toward my goals safely.
Kacper is very supportive, knowledgeable, and always takes the time to answer my questions or make adjustments when needed. He explains everything clearly, so you understand not only what to do, but also why you’re doing it.
Thanks to his guidance, I’ve become much more consistent, improved my physique, and learned how to approach nutrition and training in a balanced way without feeling like I’m constantly on a strict diet.
If you’re looking for someone professional, motivating, and genuinely involved in your progress, I would definitely recommend Kacper !
I highly recommend it Kacper  for his professional approach to diet and training- good motivation;)! After 5 months I’m 10 kg lighter - I feel amazing , I can’t wait for more changes!💪🤕

I’ve been a client of Kacper for the last 6 months. Thanks to him I achieved my body goals. He provided a comprehensive help all the time. The plan for diet and training was specialised and adjusted to my needs and capabilities, which was checked by him every week. He was available for me pretty much 24/7, when I had questions, doubts or when I needed a little motivation, he was there for me. Thank you Kacper.

I can recommend Kacper with confidence. The biggest surprise for me was realising I didn’t have to give up the foods I actually enjoy to lose weight and improve my physique. The nutrition plan was built around my preferences and normal life, rather than forcing me to eat from a rigid meal plan. Over time my waist came down, my shape became much more balanced and my upper body started looking noticeably better. On top of that, the training plan was clear, adjustments were made when needed, and everything was explained so I understood what we were doing and why. If you want to lose fat without crash dieting and build a better physique at the same time, I’d definitely recommend him.

Na sali treningowej nie ma taryfy ulgowej ani taryfy małżeńskiej. Jest surowo i konkretnie. Kiedy padam ze zmęczenia, a on mówi swoje legendarne: „jeszcze dwa, dasz radę!” – po prostu zaciskam zęby i robię to.

bodyFull.en: I'm Kacper Kaszowski, founder of KK Coaching and a personal trainer based in Cwmbran. I did not get into fitness because staying in shape had always been easy for me. I started at around 117 kg, struggled with my confidence and made many of the same mistakes that hold people back: overcomplicating nutrition, chasing quick results and not knowing whether my training was actually working. Through consistency, education and a more structured approach, I reached 76 kg and later completely rebuilt my physique. That process taught me the difference between a plan that looks impressive on paper and one a real person can follow for long enough to produce results. Today I use that experience to help people lose fat, build muscle, train with confidence and create routines they can maintain in real life.
bodyFull.pl: Nazywam się Kacper Kaszowski i prowadzę KK Coaching. Zanim zacząłem pomagać innym, sam przeszedłem drogę od około 117 kg do 76 kg, a później krok po kroku przebudowałem sylwetkę. Po drodze popełniłem sporo błędów: za bardzo komplikowałem dietę, szukałem szybkich efektów i zmieniałem rzeczy, zanim zdążyły zadziałać. Z czasem zrozumiałem, że wynik robi nie najbardziej ekstremalny plan, tylko taki, który jest dobrze dopasowany i realizowany wystarczająco długo. Dziś wykorzystuję to doświadczenie w pracy z podopiecznymi — przy redukcji, budowaniu mięśni, powrocie do regularności i nauce sensownego treningu.

bodyShort.en: I'm Kacper Kaszowski, founder of KK Coaching and a personal trainer in Cwmbran. I started at around 117 kg and reached 76 kg before rebuilding my physique, so I know the difference between another short-term fix and a plan you can actually keep following.
